title: Forward and back steps

steps.text: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and clear floor in front of you.
Step forward with one foot, then bring the other foot up beside it.
Step back with the first foot, then bring the other foot back beside it.
Keep going at a steady pace. Halfway through, lead with the other foot.
steps.cue: Steady pace. Change the leading foot halfway.

mistakes: Taking steps so long that you lunge.
Stepping back without clear floor behind you.
regression: Take short steps, and stay close to a wall you can touch.
stopIf: Stop if you feel dizzy, sick, very short of breath, or any pain in your chest.

anatomy.why: Stepping forward and back keeps the thighs and calves working in a steady rhythm.
